items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: it's Charlie's brother, don't mess with them

ctx.x: Might have been the man who studied with him.

I think so. I think that's what it would be. Because he had a lot of students, he turned some very good scholars out. Just like I said, my brother was a kid and he could play violin very good. And this boy Benny Harmon, with Leffier, he went to California and played with some white man, I don't know who or where, but I haven't seen him since. He was very, very good. In them days the boys was, they didn't carry knives and things like that, but they had little gangs and when they'd come take lessons at Professor…
Some of the tough kids up in the Irish channel used to do that too.
